question: For alien data, how many of the top 10 states by alien population have a higher percentage of friendly aliens than hostile aliens, with an average alien age exceeding 200?
sql:
WITH state_pop AS (
  SELECT state
  FROM (
    SELECT state, COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
    ORDER BY total_count DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    ad.state
  FROM alien_data ad
  WHERE ad.state IN (SELECT state FROM state_pop)
  GROUP BY ad.state
  HAVING 
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
    AND AVG(ad.age) > 200
);
